purpose: Research leads for a Motala-specific policy simulation. Literature findings are not calibrated Motala parameters.

sources.title: SystemDynamics
sources.reviewScope: Repository README and generated component documentation
sources.finding: Provides stock-and-flow modeling in Modelica. Repository release 2.1.2 targets MSL 4.0.0.
sources.implication: Candidate library for capacity and capital dynamics. Preserve explicit annual accounting when coupling continuous rates to yearly observations.
sources.limitation: Software capability does not establish empirical relationships or forecast accuracy.

sources.title: Regional Economic Growth and Municipal Financial Planning: An Application of a System Dynamics Model to Calgary
sources.reviewScope: Abstract, model structure, calibration and limitations sections
sources.finding: Combines demographic, staffing, infrastructure and fiscal feedbacks; calibrated against dozens of series over 1990–2008.
sources.implication: Use documented stocks, flows and delays with local calibration.
sources.limitation: Historical fit and scenario use do not establish superior held-out forecasting for Motala. Canadian tax structure cannot be transferred directly.

sources.title: Konjunkturläget mars 2024
sources.reviewScope: PDF text via research browser, printed page 44 and repeated on page 78, Demografisk framskrivning av kommunal konsumtion; original file not downloaded locally
sources.finding: Projects service categories using age-specific demographic weights, with assumptions about staffing, purchases, fees, wages and prices.
sources.implication: Separate service volumes from unit costs and expose staffing assumptions.
sources.limitation: National sector projection methodology is not evidence of Motala forecast precision.

sources.title: Ausgabenseitige Effekte der demografischen Entwicklung auf die Kommunalfinanzen
sources.finding: Municipal data for Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, 2000–2016, show higher per-capita expenditure associated with population decline and persistent costs.
sources.implication: Test fixed costs and delayed capacity adjustment rather than proportional cost reductions.
sources.limitation: Different national responsibilities and institutions; estimate Swedish/Motala effects rather than importing coefficients.

sources.title: Att prognostisera det finansiella resultatet i svenska kommuner: en jämförelse mellan ett elastiskt nät och en baseline
sources.reviewScope: Repository abstract only; validation design not yet audited
sources.finding: Reports elastic-net forecasts outperforming OLS over 2002–2018, with ridge performing best.
sources.implication: Investigate regularized cross-municipality estimation as a statistical comparator.
sources.limitation: Student thesis, not peer-reviewed proof of superiority to SKR or municipal budgets; full evaluation protocol needs review.

dataNeeded: care recipients or hours by age
proposedNextExperiment.validation: Fit using earlier years, compare sector costs and annual results at matched information dates against simple baselines and municipal projections. Existing 2018–2025 observations are development evidence.
